metadata.title: Instant Messaging

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for asynchronous, immediate text-based communication supporting informal collaboration and coordination.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Instant messaging platforms, chat services, and asynchronous collaboration backplanes.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern for asynchronous text communication with bounded participation, identity attribution, and message persistence.

props.name: data-entity
props.remarks: Instant messages, delivery status, participant identifiers, timestamps, and message retention metadata.

props.name: depends-on-pattern
props.remarks: Instant Messaging inherits baseline collaboration trust properties from Collaboration Core.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Instant messaging commonly occurs from remote and unmanaged endpoints and must be governed accordingly.

metadata.remarks: Instant Messaging defines asynchronous, text-based communication characterized by immediacy without continuous presence. While often informal, instant messaging significantly influences trust decisions, social engineering risk, and information leakage. This pattern governs identity attribution, participation boundaries, message persistence, and accountability while relying on Collaboration Core for baseline trust invariants.

components.title: Identity Attribution and Representation
components.description: Ensures instant messages are accurately attributable to the authenticated sender and correctly represent identity context.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Masquerading by altering display names or identifiers in instant messaging contexts.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Use of valid accounts to impersonate authority or conduct social engineering via instant messages.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Strong identity binding ensures messages are accurately attributable to their sender.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Instant message senders are authenticated and attributable.
Identity attributes are managed to ensure correct display and interpretation.

components.title: Conversation Boundary and Participation Control
components.description: Constrains who may initiate, participate in, or observe instant messaging conversations.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Abuse of trusted relationships to gain unauthorized access to chat conversations.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Membership and role-based access control restrict conversation participation.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Access to instant messaging conversations is explicitly managed.

components.title: Message Persistence and Auditability
components.description: Provides governance over message retention, deletion, and auditability to support accountability and compliance.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Deletion or suppression of instant message evidence to evade accountability.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Logging and retention of message activity supports investigation and compliance.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Instant messaging events are defined and logged.
Audit review supports detection of misuse or policy violations.
